title: Map overlay layers
description: Reference layers shown in the map's Layers panel. Edited by hand; see the comments at the top of overlays.yaml.

layers.description: One entry per layer in the Layers panel, in the order they appear.

id.description: Unique identifier for this layer. Used internally; never shown to users. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.

label.description: Name shown to the user in the Layers panel.

source.description: Which tileset to draw from. Must be a key under `overlays` in public/manifest.json, i.e. an entry under `overlays` in tools/data-build/build-config.yaml, e.g. roads. Two layers may share one source.

draw.description: How features are drawn. Must match the tileset's geometry.

visible.description: Whether the layer is switched on when the app opens. Defaults to off.

width.description: Thickness multiplier. 1 is the default thickness, 2 is twice as thick. Applies to lines and points; ignored for polygons.

where.description: Optional. Draw only the features whose column matches this value. Use it to split one tileset into several layers.

column.description: Column in the tileset to test.

equals.description: Keep features whose column equals this value.

categoricalStyle.description: A colour per distinct value of a column. Each value becomes a legend row the user can switch on and off.

column.description: Column in the tileset whose values decide the colour.

categories.description: One entry per value to colour. Values not listed here are hidden, unless `other` is set below.

value.description: The value in the column, exactly as it appears in the data. Quote it if it is text. Numbers must be whole.

label.description: Name shown in the legend for this value.

other.description: Optional. Adds a legend row for every value not listed in `categories`. Leave it out to hide those features instead.

color.description: Hex colour, e.g. "#2171b5". Quotes are required.
